critique: The render has a credible white-on-dark snowfall look, with varied small flake sizes and clear downward movement between t1 and t4. However, the snow is confined to a narrow, centered rectangular column rather than reading as an all-over snowy-night field. Density also ramps substantially from sparse at t1 to crowded at t4, making the effect feel like a simulation starting up instead of a stable preset state. The pure black background is harsher than a night-sky presentation.

suggestions.why: Widen the emitter so snowfall occupies most of the frame instead of a visibly constrained central column.
Shorten particle life to reach a stable-looking particle population sooner and reduce the major density difference between the sampled times.
Compensate for the shorter life while preserving a full, wintry snowfall density.
A very dark blue-black gives the flakes a more natural snowy-night context than absolute black.
